# DopaBrain - Extended Scientific & Application Directory

> DopaBrain (https://dopabrain.com) is an interactive mental wellness, cognitive training, and psychological self-discovery platform. All tools are browser-based, instant, privacy-first (all computation runs locally client-side), and fully localized across 12 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Hindi, Indonesian, and Turkish.

---

## Technical & Architectural Overview

- **Canonical Origin**: `https://dopabrain.com/`
- **Supported Languages (12)**: `en` (English), `ko` (Korean), `ja` (Japanese), `zh` (Simplified Chinese), `es` (Spanish), `pt` (Portuguese), `de` (German), `fr` (French), `ru` (Russian), `hi` (Hindi), `id` (Indonesian), `tr` (Turkish).
- **Execution Model**: Client-side execution (vanilla JavaScript / HTML5 / CSS3 / Web Audio API). User responses are never transmitted to external servers or logged.
- **Accessibility & Compliance**: Minimum touch target >= 44x44px, 0px horizontal overflow across all mobile viewports (390x844 standard), WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color contrast.
- **Monetization & Ad Quality**: Pure AdSense Auto Ads with zero reward gates, zero forced interstitial locks, and strict invalid traffic protection.

---

## 1. Flagship Psychological & Cognitive Tools

### Stress Check & Decompression Suite
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/`
- **Sub-pages**:
  - `https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/plan.html` (Personalized Recovery Plan)
  - `https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/script.html` (Boundary Setting Scripts)
  - `https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/library.html` (Somatic Exercise Library)
- **Scientific Framework**: Grounded in Cohen's Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10; Cohen, Kamarck, & Mermelstein, 1983) and Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome (GAS).
- **Assessment Dimensions**:
  1. *Physical Stress*: Somatic manifestations including muscle tension, cardiovascular reactivity, fatigue, and autonomic arousal.
  2. *Emotional Stress*: Irritability, emotional lability, anxiety, and feelings of being overwhelmed.
  3. *Cognitive Stress*: Mental fog, indecision, intrusive worries, and working memory fatigue.
- **Output & Decompression Tools**: Categorizes users into Mild, Moderate, or Severe stress levels, delivering evidence-based interventions including Andrew Huberman's cyclic physiological sigh, Jacobson's progressive muscle relaxation, and contextual workplace/interpersonal boundary scripts.

### HSP Sensitivity Test & Sensory Recovery
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/`
- **Sub-pages**:
  - `https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/reset.html` (Sensory Reset Protocol)
  - `https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/map.html` (Sensitivity Dimension Mapping)
- **Scientific Framework**: Dr. Elaine N. Aron's Sensory Processing Sensitivity (SPS) model and the Highly Sensitive Person Scale (HSPS; Aron & Aron, 1997).
- **Assessment Dimensions (The DOES Model)**:
  1. *Depth of Processing (D)*: Thorough subconscious evaluation of environmental nuances, deep reflective contemplation.
  2. *Overstimulation (O)*: Susceptibility to sensory overload from bright lights, loud noise, chaotic crowds, or high-intensity schedules.
  3. *Emotional Reactivity & Empathy (E)*: Heightened mirror neuron activity, intense emotional empathy, and deep resonance with others' emotional states.
  4. *Sensing the Subtle (S)*: Sensitivity to minor stimuli such as subtle scents, textures, tonal shifts, and micro-expressions.
- **Output & Tools**: Scores sensitivity across Low, Moderate, High, and Orchids (Extreme). Provides the Sensory Reset Protocol with low-contrast visual themes, brown noise frequencies, and vagus nerve stimulation exercises.

### Future Self Continuity & Temporal Discounting
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/future-self/`
- **Scientific Framework**: Hal E. Hershfield's Future Self Continuity paradigm (Hershfield et al., 2011; Journal of Marketing Research / Social Psychological and Personality Science).
- **Assessment Dimensions**:
  - *Future Vividness*: Clarity with which a person imagines their life 10 years in the future.
  - *Temporal Connectedness*: Degree of emotional alignment and obligation felt toward the future self.
  - *Temporal Discounting*: Propensity to value short-term gratification over long-term compound outcomes.
- **Output**: Generates a future self continuity score, identifying psychological barriers to savings, health habits, and career resilience with personalized visualization exercises.

### Dilemma Decision Matrix (Pugh Matrix Multi-Criteria Analysis)
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/decision-matrix.html`
- **Methodology**: Stuart Pugh's Controlled Convergence method and Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA).
- **Core Functionality**:
  - Evaluates two competing choices against multi-weighted criteria (Financial & Career Upside, Mental Wellbeing & Low Stress, Long-Term Alignment, Daily Energy & Feasibility).
  - Normalizes subjective anxiety into objective 1–5 weighting tiers and 1–10 criterion rating sliders.
  - Generates transparent, mathematical margin breakdowns, eliminating choice fatigue and cognitive paralysis with private local client execution.
  - Deep cross-funnel bridges to Stress Check, Future Self Continuity, and Emotion Regulation Planner.

### Emotion Regulation Planner (Gross Process Model)
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotion-regulation-planner.html`
- **Scientific Framework**: Dr. James J. Gross's Extended Process Model of Emotion Regulation (Gross, 1998, 2015; Review of General Psychology).
- **5-Stage Sequential Interventions**:
  1. *Situation Selection*: Proactive avoidance or intentional approach toward emotionally charged contexts.
  2. *Situation Modification*: Modifying external physical or social surroundings to diminish emotional friction.
  3. *Attentional Deployment*: Redirection of cognitive focus via distraction, physiological anchoring, or mindful focus.
  4. *Cognitive Reappraisal*: Re-evaluating the meaning or significance of an event to transform subjective emotional load.
  5. *Response Modulation*: Regulating physiological and expressive output (cyclic sighing, progressive muscle relaxation).

### Burnout vs Stress Differential Matrix
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/burnout-stress-differential.html`
- **Scientific Framework**: Differential assessment separating acute sympathetic nervous system tension (Perceived Stress Scale, Cohen et al.) from chronic occupational exhaustion & cynicism (Maslach Burnout Inventory, MBI).
- **Core Functionality**:
  - 6-question differential diagnostic matrix mapping user friction onto a 2D coordinate grid (Crisis Overload, Acute Stress, Chronic Burnout, Balanced Adaptation).
  - Calculates situational tension vs. systemic depletion percentages with localized tactical recovery steps.
  - Native Web Share API integration and cross-funnel bridges to Stress Check and Burnout Stage Test.

### Dopamine Detox & Reset Protocol Planner
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/dopamine-detox-protocol.html`
- **Neurobiological Framework**: Receptor down-regulation and behavioral stimulus control separating hyper-stimulating algorithmic novelties (cheap dopamine) from intrinsic compound mastery (compound dopamine).
- **Core Functionality**:
  - 8-metric behavioral questionnaire measuring instant digital reward habituation and sustained attention capacity.
  - Dynamically calculates the Cheap vs. Compound Dopamine Friction Ratio (%) and neural receptor status.
  - Generates a customized 24-hour reset timetable (Morning Screen Fast, Sensory-Silent Lunch, Somatic Discharge, Digital Sunset).
  - Provides an ADHD-friendly 3-tier 'Dopamine Menu' (Appetizers, Entrees, Desserts) for low-friction behavioral substitution.
  - Native Web Share API integration and cross-funnel bridges to Stress Check and Future Self Continuity.

### 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding & Panic Reset Tool
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/grounding-exercise.html`
- **Neurobiological Framework**: Polyvagal theory and somatic de-escalation targeting acute sympathetic autonomic arousal (panic, sensory flooding, dissociation) via sensory anchoring and parasympathetic vagal stimulation.
- **Core Functionality**:
  - Interactive 5-checkpoint progressive sensory walk-through: 5 Visual, 4 Tactile, 3 Auditory, 2 Olfactory, 1 Gustatory.
  - Somatic Checkpoint Runner: User logs tangible real-world anchors to shift cognitive focus from amygdala threat loops back to prefrontal somatic processing.
  - Integrated Physiological Cyclic Sigh: Guided 2-inhale, 1-exhale breathwork widget based on Huberman neurobiology protocols to rapidly reduce autonomic heart rate and restore calm.
  - Native Web Share API integration and cross-funnel bridges to Stress Check and HSP Sensory Profile.

### Cognitive Load & Brain Fog Calculator
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/cognitive-load-calculator.html`
- **Cognitive Framework**: Sweller's Cognitive Load Theory (Intrinsic, Extraneous, and Germane Load) and Baddeley's Model of Working Memory (Central Executive, Phonological Loop, Visuospatial Sketchpad).
- **Core Functionality**:
  - 8-metric executive function audit measuring working memory saturation, open loop anxiety, sensory noise friction, and decision fatigue.
  - Dynamically calculates Mental RAM Utilization (%), Available Cognitive Headroom, and Working Memory Drain.
  - Real-time client-side device telemetry integrating memory heuristics and hardware concurrency context.
  - Generates tailored executive decompression protocols (Working Memory Dump, Sensory Defiltration, Decision Batching) with quick-action checklists.
  - Native Web Share API integration and cross-funnel bridges to Stress Check, HSP Test, and Dopamine Reset Protocol.

### 2048 Strategy Coach & Tactical Trainer
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/puzzle-2048/coach.html`
- **Interactive Methodology**:
  - Dynamic game state analysis identifying board corner-locking (keeping the maximum tile anchored in a designated corner).
  - Monotonic row/column formation (ensuring decreasing numerical values along edges to avoid trapping tiles).
  - Snake pattern building (maintaining serpentine chains from 2048 to 1024, 512, 256, 128).
  - Undo analysis detecting tactical blunders and explaining optimal move directions (Up, Down, Left, Right).

### Brain Type Quiz (5-Dimension Cognitive Profile)
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/brain-type/`
- **Scientific Grounding**: Cognitive psychology paradigms combining Sternberg's triarchic theory of intelligence and contemporary cognitive preference models.
- **Dimensions Measured**:
  1. *Analytical*: Systematic, logical problem decomposition.
  2. *Creative*: Divergent thinking and novel association generation.
  3. *Strategic*: Long-horizon planning, risk assessment, and game-theoretic navigation.
  4. *Intuitive*: Rapid pattern recognition and subconscious synthesis.
  5. *Empathetic*: Social cognition, interpersonal resonance, and collaborative alignment.

### IQ & Abstract Matrix Reasoning Challenge
- **Primary URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/iq-test/`
- **Scientific Framework**: Non-verbal matrix reasoning inspired by Raven's Progressive Matrices (Raven, 1938) and Cattell's concept of fluid intelligence ($G_f$).
- **Features**: Culture-fair, language-independent 3x3 visual grid puzzles requiring geometric transformation deduction, topological rotation, and logical set operations.

---

## 2. Personality, Relationship & Self-Discovery Suite

### Dark Core Test (D-Factor)
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/dark-core/`
- **Scientific Basis**: Moshagen, Hilbig, & Zettler (2018) Dark Factor of Personality ($D$). Measures shared variance across Machiavellianism, narcissism, moral disengagement, and psychological entitlement while maintaining constructive, non-judgmental self-reflection.

### Emotional Age Assessment
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/emotional-age/`
- **Assessment**: Evaluates emotional maturity, self-regulation, impulse control, and perspective-taking relative to chronological age.

### Love Language Test
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/love-language/`
- **Framework**: Gary Chapman's 5 Love Languages (Words of Affirmation, Quality Time, Receiving Gifts, Acts of Service, Physical Touch).

### Red / Green Flag Relationship Test
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/red-green-flag/`
- **Assessment**: Evaluates interpersonal boundary health, communication patterns, emotional safety markers, and gaslighting/stonewalling red flags.

### Animal Personality Test
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/animal-personality/`
- **Methodology**: Archetypal behavior profiling assessing social drive, stress coping, leadership inclination, and conflict styles through intuitive animal metaphors.

### Toxic Trait Self-Audit
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/toxic-trait/`
- **Methodology**: Cognitive-behavioral self-awareness screener identifying passive-aggressive tendencies, defensive projection, people-pleasing, and emotional avoidance.

### K-POP Role Roster
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/kpop-position/`
- **Sub-pages**: `https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/kpop-role-roster.html`
- **Methodology**: Interactive group dynamics tool evaluating leadership, visual creative flair, harmonic support, and center stage performance drive.

### Burnout Risk Screener
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/burnout-test/`
- **Scientific Framework**: Maslach Burnout Inventory (MBI; Maslach & Jackson, 1981) measuring emotional exhaustion, depersonalization/cynicism, and reduced personal accomplishment.

### Cognitive Distortions Identifier
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/cognitive-distortions/`
- **Framework**: Aaron Beck & David Burns Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) distortion taxonomy (catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, emotional reasoning, overgeneralization).

### Emotion Iceberg Explorer
- **URL**: `https://dopabrain.com/emotion-iceberg/`
- **Methodology**: Emotional granularity framework separating secondary emotional reactions (surface level) from primary emotional roots (submerged level).
